clue.text: Notices Paul involved in thought

indicators.note: involved means tangled up, so the letters of the two words are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone muses about what Paul has been mixed up in, judging by the notices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved' is the anagram signal: NOTICES and PAUL together give exactly eleven letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Speculation is conjecture, idle thinking about what might be.

clue.text: Dress showily for a bit of fun

definitions.meaning: to ..., in an older sense, is to deck oneself out ostentatiously
a practical joke or harmless trick

explanation.surface: Dressing up flamboyantly as a lark.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb means to adorn oneself gaudily; the noun is a mischievous trick played for laughs.

clue.text: Diminutive fellow; give him something to eat

parts.note: the fellow just mentioned, a chap
a pie is a baked dish to eat

explanation.surface: A small man ought to be given a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'him' points back to the fellow, a CHAP; 'give' links him to the PIE.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is an affectionate pet-form of chap, a familiar little man.

clue.text: Feast celebrated by around 1000 Buddhist priests

indicators.note: the priests' title sits around the number, enclosing it

parts.note: lamas are Tibetan Buddhist monks
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand

explanation.surface: A festival marked by about a thousand monks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' places M inside LAMAS. Lammas is an English harvest festival on 1 August.
explanation.definitionFit: Lammas is the old loaf-mass harvest holy day.

clue.text: Modern deterrents Poseidon had a hand in?

definitions.meaning: Trident is the name of the British and American submarine-launched nuclear missile
the Greek sea god is pictured holding a three-pronged spear

explanation.surface: Today's weapons, which the sea god once wielded.
explanation.definitionFit: Trident missiles are nuclear deterrents, and the sea god carried a three-pronged fork.

clue.text: Little known remedy introduced by former pupils

indicators.note: the remedy comes after, led in by the former pupils

parts.note: OBs, old boys, are former pupils of a school
a cure is a remedy

explanation.surface: An unfamiliar treatment brought in by old school-leavers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'introduced by' puts OBS in front of CURE.
explanation.definitionFit: Something obscure is unfamiliar, not widely recognised.

clue.text: Weapons that blaze away

parts.note: 'blaze away' usually means firing guns repeatedly, but these arms literally send out burning fuel

explanation.surface: Guns firing continuously.
explanation.definitionFit: These military devices project a stream of burning liquid.

clue.text: Got plans changed ages ago

indicators.note: changed means altered, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone's plans were revised a long time back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' signals the anagram of GOT and PLANS.
explanation.definitionFit: Long gone in time, far back in history.

clue.text: Avoids the water-hole, taking no chances

definitions.meaning: read literally, someone leaves a spring or well untouched
the idiom for refusing to meddle with what is already satisfactory

explanation.surface: A cautious animal steers clear of the watering place.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means refraining from interfering, not risking spoiling what is fine.

clue.text: Where our pound has a following in a sacred city

indicators.note: the words 'has a' come after the pound sign, following it

parts.note: L, from libra, abbreviates the British pound
taken as written

explanation.surface: A holy city where sterling is popular.
explanation.walkthrough: 'following' puts HAS A after L. Lhasa is the capital of Tibet, a holy Buddhist city.
explanation.definitionFit: Lhasa, Tibet's capital, is the holy seat of Tibetan Buddhism.

clue.text: Somehow dominates a county town

indicators.note: somehow suggests an unexplained process, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A local town is in some way in charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' signals the anagram of DOMINATES. Maidstone is the county town of Kent, in south-east England.
explanation.definitionFit: Maidstone is the administrative centre of Kent.

clue.text: Conciliatory go-between for William Thackeray

definitions.meaning: an old word for a peacemaker, one who reconciles
the Victorian novelist's middle name

explanation.surface: A peacemaker acting on the novelist's behalf.
explanation.definitionFit: The archaic noun means peacemaker, and the author of Vanity Fair was William Makepeace Thackeray.

clue.text: Desires made plain in our gesticulations

indicators.note: the run of letters is revealed openly inside the phrase

explanation.surface: Wishes shown clearly through our hand movements.
explanation.definitionFit: Urges are strong wishes or impulses.

clue.text: One with a down-to earth job…

definitions.text: One with a down-to earth job

parts.words: One with a down-to earth job
parts.note: a practical worker in the ordinary sense, but literally someone working the soil

explanation.surface: A sensible, practical worker.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue runs on into 16 across, where the same word's other sense, a boat's steering lever, is hinted at.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who cultivates the land, ploughing the ground.

clue.text: Slowing notably, having started fast and coming to nothing

parts.note: Lent is the Christian season of fasting
taken as written
O is the round figure zero

explanation.surface: A musical passage decelerating after a quick start and fading out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notably' hints at musical notation; 'having started' and 'coming to' just order the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Lentando is an Italian musical direction meaning gradually getting slower.

clue.text: … also accommodating for guidance at sea

definitions.meaning: the cheapest passenger quarters on a ship
the act of directing a vessel's course

explanation.surface: Continuing 14 across: a lever that also offers lodging and directs a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun names the lowest-class passenger accommodation and also the steering of a vessel.

clue.text: Condemn in so many words

definitions.meaning: a judge pronounces punishment on a convict
a grammatical group of words

explanation.surface: Judging someone at length.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass judgment on an offender, and a complete grammatical unit of words.

clue.text: Summarises the end of an innings

definitions.meaning: goes through something quickly as a recap
in cricket, the batting side's scoring is finished

explanation.surface: Recapping the closing stages of a cricket match.
explanation.walkthrough: An innings is a batting turn in cricket; when it ends, the scoring of runs is finished.
explanation.definitionFit: To recap briefly, and in cricket the scoring is done.

clue.text: Bard character to turn to greet, say

indicators.note: turn means the little word is flipped back to front

parts.note: taken as written
a word one says to greet someone

explanation.surface: A Shakespearean figure turning to welcome someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turn' reverses the first 'to' to give OT. The Bard is Shakespeare; Othello is his Moor of Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: Othello is the tragic hero of one of Shakespeare's plays.

clue.text: Depression in party returned showing no mercy

indicators.note: the groove goes inside the political party's short name
returned means the party's abbreviation is read backwards

parts.note: Lab is short for the UK Labour Party
a rut is a groove or hollow

explanation.surface: A gloomy spell in a party comes back, merciless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns LAB into BAL, and 'in' puts RUT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Brutal means savagely cruel, without pity.

clue.text: Violent behaviour of a politician in temper

indicators.note: the politician is placed within the temper

parts.note: rage is a fit of temper
MP, Member of Parliament

explanation.surface: An angry MP behaving wildly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts A and MP inside RAGE, splitting it after the R.
explanation.definitionFit: A rampage is a spell of wild, destructive conduct.

clue.text: Couldn't be better at the highest level

definitions.meaning: excellent, first-rate
literally the very summit

explanation.surface: Perfect, at the peak.
explanation.definitionFit: Tip-top means excellent and also the very top point.

clue.text: Feeling expressed at a stormy Scottish cape

definitions.meaning: fury vented, great anger shown
the windswept headland at the north-west tip of mainland Scotland

explanation.surface: Someone's emotion on a windswept Scottish headland.
explanation.walkthrough: Cape Wrath is the north-west tip of mainland Scotland.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means fierce anger and is also the name of a Scottish headland.

clue.text: Success to an apprentice is so rewarding

parts.note: a triumph is a great success
an gives the letter A
L, a learner, as on L-plates

explanation.surface: Victory for a trainee feels gratifying.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' adds A and L after TRIUMPH.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebrating a victory, marked by success and its glory.

clue.text: Carrier-pigeon recalling an epic poet

definitions.meaning: a bird trained to fly back to its loft
the Greek author of the Iliad and the Odyssey

explanation.surface: A message bird bringing an ancient bard to mind.
explanation.definitionFit: A racing pigeon that returns to its base, and the ancient Greek author of the Iliad.

clue.text: Russia's claim to Mars informally?

parts.note: the Soviet state was nicknamed 'Red', so a world it owned would carry that colour; the fourth world is nicknamed for its rusty colour

explanation.surface: Russia staking a claim to the fourth world from the sun.
explanation.definitionFit: Mars is popularly called this because of its reddish iron-oxide surface.

clue.text: Before noon he finds capital

parts.note: a.m. means before midday
a man is a male, a he

explanation.surface: In the morning he discovers a city.
explanation.walkthrough: Amman is the capital of Jordan.
explanation.definitionFit: Amman is the seat of government of Jordan.

clue.text: Apparel by Peter French finished off by Madame Guillotine

parts.note: robes are garments
Pierre is the French form of Peter

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's gowns before he lost his head.
explanation.walkthrough: Robespierre, leader of the Terror during the French Revolution, was himself guillotined in 1794.
explanation.definitionFit: The revolutionary leader was executed on the guillotine.
